findings.title: README missing
findings.message: This plugin has no README.md. People who install it and the directory's automated review read the README to learn what it does; the first line of a README in the plugin folder also stands in as the listing summary when plugin.json has no description.
findings.fix: Add a README.md to the plugin folder describing what the plugin does, how to use it, and any setup it needs, in at least 40 words. A README at the repository root also counts for a plugin in a sub-folder.

findings.title: No icon
findings.message: No icon found in the plugin. The validator looked for `icon` in plugin.json and for a file at .claude-plugin/icon.png or .svg, assets/icon.png or .svg, or a similar path.
findings.fix: Add a square PNG to the plugin folder at .claude-plugin/icon.png, or set `icon` in plugin.json to the path of a square PNG or JPEG in the plugin: 512 to 2048 px on each side, under 2 MB. SVG and WebP are not accepted. That file may become the listing icon only once: the first time the plugin is saved or submitted in the developer portal. Adding or changing it later does not change the icon.
